title: Development Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Invenex is a digital solutions company that has grown from a website development firm into a comprehensive growth partner for businesses. The company serves clients of all sizes across Asia and the Middle East, delivering custom mobility solutions, web and mobile applications, and dynamic digital marketing strategies. Invenex’s multidisciplinary team of developers, designers, and marketing professionals collaborates with industry leaders to redesign and power their digital marketplaces. The company focuses on building long-term partnerships through services such as e-commerce development and social media marketing. Invenex is committed to helping organizations unlock their potential and co-create sustainable growth stories.
  
**Role Description**
The Development Intern role is a full-time, on-site position based in Thrissur. The intern will assist in software development and programming tasks, including writing, testing, and debugging code under the guidance of senior developers. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with the development team on web and mobile projects, analyzing requirements, and contributing to technical documentation. The intern may support basic configuration, troubleshooting, and integration activities, as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams such as design and marketing to ensure project alignment. The role offers exposure to client-focused solutions and opportunities to learn modern development practices in a fast-paced environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to understand requirements, interpret data, and solve technical problems.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with team members and convey technical information clearly.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills, including familiarity with development lifecycles, frameworks, and tools.
* Candidates should possess Programming skills in at least one modern language (such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar).
* Candidates should possess basic Sales awareness to understand client needs and support solution-oriented discussions when required.
* Relevant qualifications include current enrollment in or recent completion of a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Additional beneficial skills include familiarity with web and mobile technologies, version control systems (e.g., Git), and a willingness to learn new tools and frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, manage time effectively, and adapt to changing project priorities is highly valued.

title: Security Analyst - Mobile
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
The Senior Security Consultant – Mobile Application Security Testing will be responsible for leading and executing advanced security assessments of Android, iOS, and hybrid mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience in mobile application penetration testing, mobile platform security, API security, and secure mobile application architecture reviews.
  
  
The consultant will conduct comprehensive manual security testing, identify security vulnerabilities, assess business impact, provide remediation guidance, and mentor junior team members.
  
  

* Lead and execute advanced Android and iOS application security assessments.
* Perform black-box, gray-box, and white-box mobile application penetration testing.
* Conduct static and dynamic security assessments of mobile applications.
* Perform reverse engineering and binary analysis of mobile applications.
* Assess mobile application APIs and backend services.
* Evaluate authentication, authorization, session management, cryptographic controls, and data protection mechanisms.
* Identify vulnerabilities, validate exploitability, and assess business impact.
* Assess mobile applications against OWASP Mobile Top 10 and MASVS requirements.
* Analyze application communication channels and API interactions.
* Review application architecture and mobile security controls.
* Conduct secure code review for mobile applications where required.
* Validate remediation activities and perform retesting.
* Prepare detailed technical reports and executive summaries.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and management stakeholders.
* Mentor junior consultants and conduct peer reviews of assessment reports.
* Contribute to mobile security research, testing methodologies, and tool development.

**Key Skills**

* Strong experience testing both Android and iOS applications.
* Extensive knowledge of:
* OWASP Mobile Top 10
* OWASP MASVS
* OWASP MSTG
* Mobile threat modeling concepts
* Experience identifying vulnerabilities including:
* Insecure Data Storage
* Weak Authentication
* Broken Authorization
* Insecure Communication
* Improper Certificate Validation
* SSL Pinning Bypass
* Reverse Engineering Weaknesses
* Code Tampering Risks
* Cryptographic Weaknesses
* Runtime Manipulation Risks
* API Security Vulnerabilities

**Key Competencies**

* Accountability
* Communications - Oral & Written
* Analysis Skills
* Passion
* Adaptability

**Job description** 





 We are looking to hire a talented iOS developer to design, build, and maintain the next generation of iOS applications. Your primary focus will be developing high\-end iOS applications for the latest Apple mobile devices. Your duties may include collaborating with the design team for new application features, identifying and fixing application bottlenecks, maintaining the core code, and updating applications published on the App Store.
 





 To ensure success as an iOS developer, you should have a strong working knowledge of iOS Frameworks, be proficient in Objective\-C, and be able to work as part of a team. Ultimately, an outstanding iOS developer should be able to create functional, attractive applications that perfectly meet the needs of the user.
 




**Responsibilities** 



* Designing and building mobile applications for Apple’s iOS platform.
* Collaborating with the design team to define app features.
* Ensuring quality and performance of the application to specifications.
* Identifying potential problems and resolving application bottlenecks.
* Fixing application bugs before the final release.
* Publishing applications on App Store.
* Maintaining the code and atomization of the application.
* Designing and implementing application updates.



**Requirements** 



* Proficient in Objective\-C, Swift, and Cocoa Touch.
* Extensive experience with iOS Frameworks such as Core Data and Core Animation.
* Knowledge of iOS back\-end services and MVVM architecture
* Knowledge of Apple’s design principles and application interface guidelines.
* Proficient in code versioning tools including Mercurial, Git, and SVN.
* Knowledge of C\-based libraries.
* Familiarity with push notifications, APIs, and cloud messaging.
* Experience with continuous integration.

title: Flutter Bug-Fixing Expert
description:
We are looking for an experienced Flutter developer to troubleshoot and fix critical issues in an existing live audio calling app published on Google Play Store.
 



  





 Main Responsibilities:
 



  





 Fix ZEGOCLOUD call drops, call\-state and lifecycle issues
 



 Resolve FCM incoming\-call notifications in killed/background/locked states
 



 Synchronize Flutter app, Node.js backend, WebSocket/Socket.IO call states
 



 Handle Android background services, lock screen and poor\-network scenarios
 



 Fix audio routing, microphone, speaker, earpiece and Bluetooth issues
 



 Analyze Crashlytics and Logcat errors and implement stable fixes
 



  





 Required Skills:
 



  





 Strong Flutter debugging and asynchronous programming experience
 



 Production experience with ZEGOCLOUD, Agora or WebRTC
 



 Android/iOS background and native integration knowledge
 



 Node.js and real\-time signaling experience
 



 Ability to diagnose and deliver fast, production\-ready fixes
